summary: Resolved how wpcmk_entry_and_roster_menu (wpcmk file 0x59e0) draws the static top region of the CHARACTER menu. MECHANISM: it is fully INLINE draw calls, NO data table. 0x59e0 creates 3 persistent windows then calls ui_setup_creation_windows (wpcmk 0x5093), which (1) clears the top window to (char=0x00, attr=0x01)=wfont1 solid-black, (2) clears bottomBar to (0x20,attr3)=wfont3 and menuPanel to (0x20,attr3)=wfont3, (3) ui_window_focus, (4) calls ui_draw_creation_screen_borders (wpcmk FUN_06af 0x06af) which writes ~90 individual frame/separator glyph chars into the TOP window via ui_put_styled_char_at (FUN_0689 0x0689, writes char byte only), (5) ui_window_unfocus, (6) ui_screen_refresh. FILL MODEL (corrects the open question): the attr low-nibble ONLY selects the wfont file (1/2/3/4); there is NO attribute recoloring. The framebuffer index of each pixel = the 4bpp pixel value baked into the chosen font's glyph. wfont1 glyph 0x00 = all index-0 (black); wfont3 glyph 0x20 = all index-8 (gray). So the TOP window is ENTIRELY BLACK (wfont1) with gray (idx8/idx9) frame lines from glyphs 0x01-0x15; the GRAY area in the composite is the separate menuPanel window (wfont3, 19x13 at cell (21,7)) drawn on top, NOT gray showing through the top window. CONFLICT FLAG: the engine's actual top template (verified byte-exact below) does NOT match the parent's ground-truth pixel description (parent: black title band rows0-1, black central panel cols15-33, gray sides; engine: outer frame + row-4 H-divider + col-20 V-divider, black LEFT stat panel cols0-19, GRAY RIGHT panel cols21-39). The parent's framebuffer was almost certainly captured from a DIFFERENT screen (the wpcvw character-VIEW/REVIEW sheet, or a creation sub-screen), not from 0x59e0's bare roster menu. The engine code path for 0x59e0 is unambiguous and reproduced below.
method: Disassembled wpcmk_entry_and_roster_menu (0x59e0) with capstone (Ghidra had not auto-defined this region as code; it is the unnamed top-level entry per wpcmk-screens.md §11). Decompiled ui_setup_creation_windows (0x5093) and FUN_06af (0x06af) via pyghidra 3.1.0. Decoded all 3 ui_window_create call sites (cdecl arg order) at 0x5a0b/0x5a31/0x5a57. Decompiled wroot ui_window_clear (image 0x132be) and ui_window_create (image 0x1011a) to nail the clear/struct semantics. Decoded ui_put_styled_char_at (FUN_0689) to confirm char-only write. Decoded every wfont1/wfont3 glyph used (0x00-0x15, 0x20) to palette indices via the documented 4-plane (G,B,R,I) MSB-first packing, cross-checked against packages/parser/src/formats/wfont-4bpp-render.ts. Rendered the full 320x200 index framebuffer of the composite and classified each 8x8 cell. FUN_06af cell writes are independently verified byte-exact against a live save-state cell dump in docs/re/findings/wpcmk-window-chrome.json.

findings.claim: The top template is drawn by INLINE code, not a data table. wpcmk_entry_and_roster_menu (0x59e0) calls ui_setup_creation_windows (0x5093) at file 0x5a68, which calls ui_draw_creation_screen_borders (FUN_06af, file 0x06af). FUN_06af is a flat sequence of ~90 ui_put_styled_char_at(window, x_cell, y_cell, char) calls plus a handful of small loops. There is no rectangle/label descriptor table; each cell's char is an immediate operand.

evidence.details: 0x5a68: 'call 0x5093' (ui_setup_creation_windows) with args (push *0x56ca bottomBar, push *0x546e top). 0x5093 body: ui_window_clear(top,0x00,1,0); ui_window_clear(bottomBar,0x20,3,0); ui_window_clear(menuPanel,0x20,3,0); ui_window_focus(top) [thunk 0xebb4 -> wroot image 0x13118]; call 0x06af(top); ui_window_unfocus(top) [thunk 0xec6d -> 0x131d1]; ui_screen_refresh() [thunk 0xe4ff -> 0x12a63]. FUN_06af decompile = pure inline ui_put_styled_char_at calls.

findings.claim: 0x59e0 creates 3 persistent windows via the ui_window_create thunk (wpcmk 0xbbb6 -> wroot image 0x1011a). Args (cdecl): top window = 40x20 cells at cell(0,0), attr 0x14, border 0xFFFF(=plain), handle->*0x546e (call 0x5a0b). bottomBar = 40x5 at cell(0,20), attr 0x13, handle->*0x56ca (call 0x5a31). menuPanel = 19x13 at cell(21,7), attr 0x15, handle->*0x56cc (call 0x5a57). ui_window_create stores width@[0],height@[1],x_col@[2],y_row@[3],attr@[4],flags@[5]; cells start @[0x10], 2 bytes/cell.

evidence.details: top pushes (rev) -> param_1=0(x_col),param_2=0(y_row),param_3=0x28(w=40),param_4=0x14(h=20),param_5=0x14(attr),param_6=0xffff(border),param_7=0(flags),param_8=0. bottomBar -> x=0,y=0x14,w=0x28,h=5,attr=0x13. menuPanel -> x=0x15(21),y=7,w=0x13(19),h=0xd(13),attr=0x15. ui_window_create (wroot image 0x1011a) decompile confirms struct field order and that border==0xFFFF zero-fills the 8 border-char slots (struct-level border bypassed).

findings.claim: WINDOW FILL MODEL: ui_window_clear(window, char, attr_flag, alt) sets every cell to (char, effectiveAttr). effectiveAttr = attr_flag if attr_flag!=0 else (alt<<4). The attr's LOW NIBBLE selects the wfont file (1=wfont1,2=wfont2,3=wfont3,4=wfont4). There is NO attribute-based recoloring: each pixel's framebuffer index IS the 4bpp value baked into the selected font's glyph (confirmed by wfont-tile-system.json and renderTextRun4bpp). Therefore fill color depends on (fill_char, font) only: wfont1 glyph 0x00 -> all index 0 (BLACK); wfont3 glyph 0x20 -> all index 8 (GRAY). The window's struct attr byte (0x14 for top) is OVERRIDDEN by the clear call's attr (1 for top), so the top window renders as wfont1 regardless of 0x14.

evidence.details: ui_window_clear (image 0x132be) decompile: 'if(param_3==0) param_4=param_4<<4; else param_4=param_3; ... *cell = CONCAT11(param_4,param_2)'. Top clear call (0x5093@0x5096): char=0,attr_flag=1,alt=0 -> cell=(attr=1,char=0). bottomBar/menuPanel clear: char=0x20,attr_flag=3 -> (attr=3,char=0x20). Glyph decode (4-plane MSB-first per wfont-4bpp-render.ts): wfont1[0x00]=all idx0; wfont3[0x20]=all idx8. ui_put_styled_char_at (FUN_0689 @0x0689) writes ONLY the char byte at [bx+si+0x10] (even offset), leaving attr (odd offset) = 1 from the clear -> all FUN_06af frame glyphs are wfont1.

findings.claim: The TOP window template drawn by FUN_06af (in 40x20 cell coords; window is at screen 0,0 so cell==screen-cell) is: outer frame (corners 0x01/0x03/0x06/0x08, top edge 0x02 cols1-38 row0, bottom edge 0x07 cols1-19 row19, left edge 0x04 col0 rows1-18, right edge 0x05 col39 rows1-5 + col39 row6=0x08); a full-width horizontal double-rule (char 0x0c) at row4 cols1-38; a vertical double-rule (char 0x05) at col20 (0x14) rows7-18 with cap chars at col20 rows4(0x0e)/5(0x0d)/6(0x15); LEFT stat panel sub-grid: horizontal double-rules (0x0c) at rows13,15,17 cols1-19 plus closing rule at row13 cols0-19, and vertical double-rules (0x0d) at cols2,10,12 rows14-18 with junction caps (0x0e top, 0x10 mid). Net visual: black panels framed by gray lines. The LEFT half (cols0-19) is the character stat sheet (LVL/STR/INT/... rows); the RIGHT half (cols20-39) is a large open black panel.

evidence.details: Full FUN_06af decompile transcribed (see operations list below). Independently verified byte-exact against save-1 live cell dump in wpcmk-window-chrome.json (window struct phys 0x01f46e, cells 0x01f47e): row0 = (0x01,...0x02...,0x03), etc. Note FUN_06af bottom-edge loop covers only cols1-19 (x<0x14) then the bottom-right corner 0x08 lands at col20,row19 — confirming the left panel is self-contained and the right panel's bottom edge is left as fill.

findings.claim: In the COMPOSITE roster-menu screen, the GRAY block at cells (cols 21-39, rows 7-19) is the menuPanel window (wfont3 glyph 0x20 = idx8) drawn on top of the top window, NOT the top window. The top window's own right half (cols20-39 rows5-12) is BLACK. menuPanel occupies cell(21,7) size 19x13 -> covers screen rows 7..19, cols 21..39. bottomBar (rows20-24) is wfont3 0x20 = idx8 gray. So the full-screen index map is: black creation stat panel on the left, gray menuPanel on the right, gray bottom bar.

evidence.details: menuPanel create (0x5a57): w=0x13,h=0xd,x=0x15,y=7. Cleared (0x5093@0x50c0) with (char=0x20,attr=3)=wfont3 glyph0x20=idx8. Rendered composite (top=wfont1 template UNDER, menuPanel=wfont3 gray OVER): cols0-19=black stat panel w/ gray frame, col20=gray V-divider, cols21-39 rows7-19=solid idx8 gray.

findings.claim: The parent's ground-truth top-region description does NOT match what wpcmk_entry_and_roster_menu (0x59e0) draws. Parent describes: solid-black title band rows0-1; black central panel cols15-33 rows7-14 with gray cols0-14 and cols34-39; label rows 16/18/20 with two ~7-cell black bars on gray. Engine 0x59e0 draws: NO solid black title band (rows0-3 are black framed by gray rule at row0 & row4); divider at col20 not col15/34; black LEFT panel cols0-19 / gray RIGHT panel cols21-39 (the MIRROR of the parent's black-center/gray-sides). The parent's screen most plausibly is the wpcvw character-VIEW/REVIEW sheet (REVIEW PC dispatches to wpcmk 0x545c which likely calls a wpcvw char-sheet redraw) or a creation sub-screen, NOT the bare roster menu. RECOMMENDATION: confirm via a live DOSBox-X framebuffer capture at the exact CHARACTER menu state and compare to the cell map in this finding before porting; if the parent truly wants the screen they pixel-sampled, RE the wpcvw char-view sheet instead.

evidence.details: Engine composite (cell classification, B=black F=gray-frameline g=gray): rows0/4/6(right)/13/15/17/19 are frame rules; cols0-19 black stat panel; col20 V-divider; cols21-39 rows7-19 gray menuPanel; rows20-24 gray bottom bar. Parent's described black-central-panel/gray-sides is geometrically the mirror and includes a solid-black rows0-1 title band absent from FUN_06af.
